scope: Static source inspection only. No PowerShell helper, Windows process, UIA, native GUI, Rust compiler, local test or CI execution.
host_wait_bound: remaining max(0, 30s - actual process UTC age), monotonic stopwatch caps remaining wait; each read checks same PID/start; sleep at most250ms
host_files: fresh setup mandatory registry.json and extensions/registry.json only, JSON parsed once after both appear
UIA_bound: WaitForExit consumes remaining3s from observer stopwatch; timeout only signals exact helper PID/start; original main cleanup block unchanged
type_review: WindowsPowerShell5.1 supports param(long,int,string), ::new(), Add-Type UIAutomationClient/UIAutomationTypes and ConvertTo-Json. No PowerShell7-only API in helper.
Parent runs pwsh per existing workflow; ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable is used only there.
FromHandle(IntPtr), FindFirst(TreeScope, Condition), AndCondition(Condition,Condition) and PropertyCondition(AutomationProperty,object) match official managed UIA signatures.
GetProcessById(int), StartTime.ToUniversalTime().Ticks(long), WaitForExit(int) and Kill() are existing .NET process APIs; UIA helper is separately spawned and owns no Horizon process.
No setup marker files are assumed from lazy settings/appearance writes.
runtime_validation: not executed; real UIA availability/ready state remains to be observed on a future already-authorized Windows run
